info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Operational Services Disbursement-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Disbursement Management API allows financial institutions to efficiently process disbursement transactions within their operational services. This endpoint facilitates the initiation of disbursements, enabling businesses to manage funds transfer seamlessly and securely. Typical consumers include banking and financial service providers aiming to automate and streamline their disbursement workflows. Use cases involve processing loan disbursements, payment distributions, and other financial transactions that require reliable and timely execution.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new disbursement within the operational services. Make sure to provide all necessary details in the request body to successfully process the disbursement.
